cases.bad: fixtures bad (no "marker sweep"), pair-other (v0.3.0 disabled a definition for another reason) and the complete leftover snapshot must fail
cases.good: fixture good (a real N-1 boot log) and pair-empower (v0.3.0 disabled the Empower definition) must pass; a leftover without saved\ or its manifest is not refused

cases.bad: a leftover manifest, two held snapshots, another server path, a corrupted saved copy and a running server are refused with the live trees unchanged
cases.good: a save and restore round trip with a hidden file, where a DLL and a cfg added after the save are removed
cases.empty: an absent config folder and an empty directory are restored as saved; no scratch install prints 0/6

cases.bad: stub parts: repo, drill or snapshot failing alone fails the gate, naming it
cases.good: stub parts all passing print "rollback gate: 3/3"
cases.empty: a part exiting 0 without its success line fails the gate

cases.bad: a local asset whose hash differs from the audit's line fails
cases.good: a local asset whose hash equals the audit's "zip sha256:" line passes
cases.empty: a missing asset, and an audit without the line, fail

cases.bad: a scratch repository whose range holds a merge commit: git refuses the revert and the drill fails
cases.good: a scratch repository with a clean range reverts to the older tag and passes

cases.bad: the fails-when inputs of faction-empowerment D1-D14 and D20, one test each; a failing or skipped test fails the run
cases.empty: a run with 0 tests passed (a filter matching nothing) has no success line and fails
